info.title: Shared pricing configuration API
info.description: Shared pricing configuration and merchant-managed tax APIs. Global template publication validates definitions and the deployed rule registry; merchant initialization/publication/runtime still require actual owner capability and tax evidence. Platform defaults and merchant overrides take effect without approval. Calculation ports are backend-only; no client tax-rate override.

config.description: EffectivePricingConfig: definition(schemaVersion=2), rules, canonicalJson, configHash; no executable script

ManualAdjustmentRequest.description: PERCENT requires payableRateBp only; AMOUNT/WAIVER require amountMinor only. ROUNDING is a declared enum but currently rejected. Real source, role, limits and distinct approval are revalidated server-side.
